The amount of merit concession you will receive depends on your CGPA at the end of the academic year, provided you meet all eligibility conditions [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2, §3].

The concession is calculated as a percentage of your annual tuition based on the following slabs:
*   **9.00 and above:** 25% of annual tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]
*   **8.50 – 8.99:** 15% of annual tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]
*   **8.00 – 8.49:** 10% of annual tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]
*   **Below 8.00:** Not eligible [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]

To determine the specific monetary value, the slab percentage is multiplied by the annual tuition listed in the current year's Fee Structure for your department and year of study [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §4]. 

Please note that the provided documents do not contain your specific CGPA, your department, your year of study, or the current annual tuition amount, so I cannot calculate the exact live amount for you.
